what: SessionStart test plan only uses a failing python3 stub when no claude-implement-* dirs exist
scenario_or_breakage: The new fail-open path that matters is a non-zero resolver after the pre-check passes. With the proposed no-dir case, an implementation can skip Python or call Python and swallow the failure, and the test still may not prove the no-spawn contract. A set -e command-substitution bug with a stale session dir would remain unverified and could make SessionStart exit nonzero.
suggested_fix: Split this into two minimal cases: no session dirs with a marker stub and an assertion that python3 was not invoked, plus one dummy claude-implement-* dir with a failing python3 stub asserting rc 0 and empty stdout.
